predictive_innovation.definition: Norm of the actual noisy reading minus the pre-update posterior mean, divided by sqrt(component latent variance + sensor noise variance). A diagnostic of local predictive calibration; no independent-data or safety guarantee.

replay_verification.definition: Replay saved references and MBD parameters from the exact original initial condition through unchanged dynamics, full POAM and RPCBF. Regenerate sensor noise with the original seed. Never initialize from rounded map/state recordings. Check positions against full-precision observation positions and other values against recording precision. Continue optimization only after this verified prefix.

protocol_audit.reviewed_driver_changes: Exact matched-duration scheduling and its legacy capacity allocation; diagnostic labels; compact recording buffers that serialize byte-identically; optional verified replay of saved decisions after storage interruption. Replay starts from the original initial condition and regenerates actual measurements through the unchanged model. No physical timestep, inference, actuator limit, controller or monitoring objective changes.
protocol_audit.note: Only legacy allocation capacity may be padded to a five-second block. The intended experiment horizon and actual physics steps are separately recorded.

scope: All fresh declared center-in-B trials; no run is removed based on outcome. Earlier diagnostics remain separately archived.
comparison: Same initial state, physical model, observation-noise seed, POAM, full uncertainty, MBD and execution filter. Baseline survey + 300 s versus equal proposed total time; all survey monitoring cost counts.
limitations: Different global RMSE and task-posterior stopping domains; both must pass the same finite task-cost validation.
A successful example is not a collision-free guarantee or evidence across all initial conditions.
Finite wind sampling and possible model misspecification remain; infeasible commands and collisions are reported.
